title: Choose what to air when the save call becomes ready

observations.description: Aston Villa attacker at the top of the box nudges the ball rightward under pressure as Arsenal defenders close in.
The ball is poked or deflected toward the inside-right edge of the penalty area, with defenders and an attacker converging on it.
The ball pops up off the ground in the same attacking area after the challenge, staying live near the penalty arc.
The goalkeeper dives left and gets a hand to the shot, pushing the ball away from the center of goal.
A defender slides in near the six-yard area and knocks the loose ball away from goal.
